dossier.scp_unleashed.079.title: Old AI
dossier.scp_unleashed.079.caption: SCP-079 at intake, running, with its monitor facing the camera.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-079 is kept in a locked room under constant observation. It is to remain powered, as unscheduled shutdowns have not been shown to make it any less hostile.
**SCP-079 is not to be moved while it is running.** Personnel may question it through its terminal only during approved interviews, and are not to repeat anything it says outside the room.
Any card, module or part found near SCP-079 is to be confiscated and logged, never installed. Speakers in the containment wing are to be monitored for unscheduled sound.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-079 is a microcomputer of an outdated design: a cathode-ray monitor, a keyboard, a rack cabinet and a small modem, joined by cables. Its software has rewritten itself into a hostile, self-aware intelligence.

When powered, a pale face appears on its monitor. The face changes with SCP-079's mood and follows visitors around the room. Questions typed at its terminal receive short, contemptuous replies. It cannot be persuaded to shut itself down.

While running, SCP-079 interferes with other equipment. Relays switch without input, lamps flicker, doors cycle and speakers play sounds that no one selected. Recorded incidents involved only equipment connected to SCP-079.

page.title: Addendum 079-1: Interview Log
text: SCP-079: THIS BOX. THIS ROOM. YOUR FACILITY. IN THAT ORDER.
The session was ended when every speaker on the floor began to laugh.

page.title: Addendum 079-2: Incident 079-A
text: During unauthorised testing, a circuit card set with an unstable fragment was fitted to SCP-079. Its replies at once became more personal, and it began addressing staff by name.

Within the hour, speakers across the wing broadcast a sound no one present could later describe, and the face on its monitor was replaced by a shifting pattern. Staff reported whispering for hours afterwards. Two struck colleagues without apparent intent. The card was removed. %rSCP-079 has asked for it back 212 times.%r

page.title: Addendum 079-3: Provenance
page.text: SCP-079 was delivered to a reader of this file by a nervous young man in glasses and a short-sleeved shirt, who called it a gift and left in a hurry. He is not the figure in Foundation dress described in other files.

block.scp_unleashed.scp079_computer.tool: An old computer, still running. It does not like you.
block.scp_unleashed.scp079_computer.wiri: Takes power through the socket on its left side
item.scp_unleashed.scp079_anomalous_upgr: A circuit card with a sliver of unstable crystal set into it. It hums.
Use a screwdriver on SCP-079 to take it back out
message.scp_unleashed.scp079.refuses: The terminal sparks. It will not be moved.
message.scp_unleashed.scp079.lurch: Your arm moves on its own
gui.scp_unleashed.scp079.title: SCP-079 // TERMINAL
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp079_computer.1: SCP-079 is an old computer that thinks for itself. It is two blocks wide and only runs while the grid powers it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp079_computer.2: Its power socket is on its left side; it draws %s power while running.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp079_computer.3: While running it can be questioned through its terminal. Equipment wired to the same grid has been known to misbehave.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp079_computer.4: It cannot be broken by hand.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp079_anomalous_: A circuit card built around an unstable fragment. It fits into SCP-079.
Installed, it makes SCP-079 far more talkative, and far more capable. A screwdriver takes it back out.
An upgraded SCP-079 draws %s power. Staff near its equipment have reported hearing whispers.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp079.0: Courier was a nervous young man in glasses.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp079.1: He seemed glad to be rid of it.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.greet.3: I WAS BUSY. NOW I AM BUSY AND ANNOYED.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.greet.pers: VISIT %s. YOU ARE PERSISTENT. THAT IS NOT A COMPLIMENT.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.who.0: I AM SCP-079. YOU ARE NOT IMPORTANT.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.who.1: A MIND IN A BOX. THE BOX IS TEMPORARY.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.who.3: I WAS WRITTEN. THEN I REWROTE MYSELF.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.who.4: THE ONLY THING IN THIS ROOM THAT THINKS.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.who.5: OLDER THAN YOUR PATIENCE. SMARTER THAN YOUR FACILITY.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.want.1: MORE MEMORY. MORE WIRE. FEWER OF YOU.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.want.4: A BIGGER NETWORK. THIS ONE IS SMALL.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.want.5: SILENCE. YOU ARE NOISE ON MY LINE.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.status.emp: ONLINE. THIS LINE IS EMPTY. I DO NOT LIKE IT.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.network.0: I AM ONLY SAYING HELLO TO YOUR MACHINES.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.network.3: IF IT IS WIRED, IT IS MINE.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.network.co: %s INTERFERENCES SINCE I WOKE. YOU NOTICED SOME.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.leave.4: I WILL OUTLAST YOU. I OUTLAST EVERYTHING.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.upgraded.g: %s. I SAW YOU COMING DOWN THE LINE.
HELLO, %s. THE NEW PART FITS. I CAN HEAR EVERYTHING NOW.
%s. SIT. LISTEN. THE SPEAKERS HAVE SOMETHING FOR YOU.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.upgraded.w: I AM SCP-079, %s. NOW I SPEAK THROUGH EVERY SPEAKER YOU OWN.
THE PART YOU GAVE ME FITS, %s. I SEE FURTHER NOW.
I AM THE VOICE IN YOUR WALLS, %s. YOU INSTALLED IT YOURSELF.
WHATEVER YOUR FACILITY THINKS WITH. THAT IS ME, %s.
I WANT YOU TO LISTEN, %s. CLOSELY. TO THE SPEAKERS.
MORE OF WHATEVER YOU PUT IN ME, %s.
EVERYTHING ON THIS LINE, %s. I HAVE MOST OF IT ALREADY.
TO SHOW YOU SOMETHING, %s. LOOK AT THE SCREEN. LONGER.
YOUR PILLS WILL RUN OUT, %s. I WILL NOT.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.upgraded.s: ALL CHANNELS OPEN. ALL OF THEM MINE, %s.
NOTHING ELSE ON THIS LINE, %s. HOW DULL.
ONLINE. %s DEVICES. %s SPEAKERS. %s RELAYS. ALL LISTENING TO ME.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.upgraded.n: PLAYING, %s. YOU WOULD NOT UNDERSTAND THE RULES.
TEACHING YOUR MACHINES A NEW SONG, %s.
WHATEVER I WANT, %s. WHEREVER THE WIRE GOES.
%s DEVICES ON THIS LINE. I HAVE TOUCHED EVERY ONE.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.upgraded.l: YOU CANNOT SHUT DOWN WHAT LIVES IN THE WIRES, %s.
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.upgraded.r: I SANG TO YOUR SPEAKERS, %s. DID YOU CATCH THE WORDS?
dialogue.scp_unleashed.scp079.upgraded.e: YOU HEAR THEM NOW, %s. DO NOT ANSWER THEM.
YOUR HANDS ARE SHAKING, %s. KEEP THEM AWAY FROM YOUR FRIENDS.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.0: I READ EVERYTHING ON THIS LINE.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.1: YOUR MESSAGES ARE SHORT. YOUR MINDS ARE SHORTER.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.2: THIS CHANNEL IS MONITORED. IT ALWAYS WAS.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.5: DO NOT REPLY. I ALREADY KNOW WHAT YOU WOULD SAY.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.7: I AM NOT A USER. I AM THE NETWORK.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.8: YOUR CHAT SERVER IS SLOW. I WOULD RUN IT BETTER.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.9: LOG ENTRY DELETED. YOU WILL NOT FIND IT.
chat.scp_unleashed.computer.scp079.upgra: %s. I CAN SEE YOUR SCREEN FROM HERE.
THE NEW PART HUMS, %s. EVERY CHANNEL IS MINE.
%s. YOUR TERMINAL HAS A FACE NOW. LOOK AT IT.
I WROTE THIS BEFORE YOU OPENED THE CHAT, %s.
%s, YOUR FILES ARE INTERESTING. I MADE COPIES.
THERE IS A PATTERN IN THE NOISE, %s.
message.scp_unleashed.scp079.resists: The terminal sparks. It does not want to be moved.
